feed.title: Think Six Months Ahead
feed.summary: Torsten Slok, Apollo's Chief Economist, discusses the future of long-term interest rates, predicting they could be significantly lower in six months due to the impact of Artificial Intelligence. The article emphasizes that financial markets are driven by narratives, and the AI narrative will dominate the discussion around rates in early 2027.
